prompt:
Fix snippets/address-block.liquid. It renders a postal address and must only output the optional wrapper elements when their value is present. Input (top-level variable, never null): `address`, an object with these keys (all keys are always supplied): - `address.company`: string or null (optional) - `address.street`: non-empty string - `address.city`: non-empty string - `address.phone`: string or null (optional) A value is "present" when it is not null and not the empty string "". Do not strip whitespace. Output, in this exact order, with no whitespace or newlines between or around elements: 1. `
` 2. Only if company is present: `COMPANY` 3. `STREET` 4. `CITY` 5. Only if phone is present: `

PHONE

` (the whole `

` wrapper is omitted when phone is absent) 6. `

` Every value (company, street, city, and phone both in the href and in the link text) must be HTML-escaped with the `escape` filter. The output must have no leading or trailing whitespace. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/address-block.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
